## 📌 About This Repository

This repository is an **automatically maintained coding progress dashboard**. Every piece of content here — the README, charts, statistics, and solution files — is generated and updated by the [**CodeStreak**](https://github.com/AdarshShinde0608/CodeStreak) automation engine.

**What gets auto-updated:**

| Artifact | Description | Updated When |
|:--------:|:------------|:------------:|
| `README.md` | Dashboard with streaks, stats, achievements, and recent submissions | Every accepted submission |
| `solutions/` | Organized solution files by platform and problem | Every accepted submission |
| `data/submissions.json` | Canonical database of all accepted submissions | Every accepted submission |
| `data/statistics.json` | Computed statistics (difficulty, language, topics) | Every pipeline run |
| `data/streak.json` | Current & longest streak, active days | Every pipeline run |
| `data/achievements.json` | Milestone achievement progress | Every pipeline run |
| `assets/heatmap.svg` | GitHub-style activity heatmap | Every pipeline run |
| `assets/difficulty.svg` | Difficulty distribution chart | Every pipeline run |
| `assets/languages.svg` | Language distribution chart | Every pipeline run |

---

## 🔗 How It Works

```
                    ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                    │    CodeStreak Browser Extension  │
                    │   (Chrome / Edge / Brave)        │
                    └───────────────┬─────────────────┘
                                    │
                   Detects accepted submissions on
              LeetCode, Codeforces, GeeksforGeeks, CodeChef
                                    │
                                    ▼
                    ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                    │   Commits solution + metadata    │
                    │   to this repo via GitHub API    │
                    └───────────────┬─────────────────┘
                                    │
                                    ▼
                    ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                    │     CodeStreak Engine Pipeline    │
                    │     (GitHub Actions Workflow)     │
                    │                                   │
                    │  1. Calculate Statistics           │
                    │  2. Calculate Streak               │
                    │  3. Update Achievements            │
                    │  4. Generate README Dashboard      │
                    │  5. Generate SVG Charts            │
                    └───────────────┬─────────────────┘
                                    │
                                    ▼
                    ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                    │  Updated dashboard pushed here   │
                    │       leetcode-journey ✅         │
                    └─────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 📊 Dashboard Sections

The auto-generated dashboard above includes:

- **🔥 Streak Summary** — Current streak, longest streak, total solved, year count
- **📊 Difficulty Breakdown** — Easy / Medium / Hard with percentages and SVG chart
- **🌐 Languages** — Programming languages used with distribution
- **🗂️ Top Topics** — Most practiced algorithm topics
- **🔥 Streak Details** — Detailed streak metrics with activity heatmap
- **🕐 Recent Submissions** — Latest 10 accepted submissions across all platforms
- **🏆 Achievements** — Milestone badges (unlocked/locked)

## 🔧 Powered By

This repository is automatically maintained by the **CodeStreak** engine:

| Component | Description |
|:---------:|:------------|
| [**CodeStreak Engine**](https://github.com/AdarshShinde0608/CodeStreak) | Python automation pipeline — statistics, streaks, achievements, dashboard generation |
| **Browser Extension** | Chrome Manifest V3 extension — captures accepted submissions from coding platforms |
| **GitHub Actions** | Automated workflows — `sync.yml` (scheduled) and `process.yml` (extension-triggered) |

### Want to set up your own?

1. Fork the [CodeStreak](https://github.com/AdarshShinde0608/CodeStreak) repository
2. Create your own `leetcode-journey` repository
3. Install the browser extension
4. Configure your GitHub token and start solving problems!

See the [CodeStreak README](https://github.com/AdarshShinde0608/CodeStreak#getting-started) for detailed setup instructions.
